summary:
#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – [Monday, 26 August 2024 at 19.26]:**  
- Submitted filled research proposal form for SensorKit variables collection via Mood Snapshot app.  
- *Key quote:* "Please find attached the filled research proposal form to collect the specified SensorKit variables through the Mood Snapshot app (ID #6503913823)."  

- **[SensorKit Request] (Review Team, Apple) – [Monday, 26 August 2024 at 19.26]:**  
- Requested an updated copy of the SensorKit proposal due to issues with text boxes on the first page.  
- *Key quote:* "Can you send an updated copy of your SensorKit proposal? It seems that the text boxes on the first page of the document have been modified so we can't copy the content inside of them to view it."  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – [Tuesday, 27 August 2024 at 16.41]:**  
- Provided updated copies of the PDF and pasted content of text boxes.  
- *Key quote:* "Unfortunately I can’t identify the PDF issue from my end seeing as I’m able to open the document and scroll through the textboxes."  

- **[SensorKit Request] (Review Team, Apple) – [Tuesday, 27 August 2024 at 16.41]:**  
- Explained the two stages of entitlements (development and distribution) and requested signed addendum and collaborator agreement.  
- *Key quote:* "We approve the development entitlement pending agreement to the addendum to the SensorKit Addendum."  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – [Friday, 30 August 2024 at 00.41]:**  
- Notified Apple about missing data types (Heart Rate, Wrist Temperature) in the Addendum and provided board approval letter & consent document.  
- *Key quote:* "Could you address the missing data types and update us on this?"  

- **[SensorKit Request] (Review Team, Apple) – [Friday, 30 August 2024 at 00.41]:**  
- Advised to complete Addendum without the two missing data types and provided updated collaborator agreement link.  
- *Key quote:* "Right now the form doesn't support those 2 data types since they are newer, but please complete the Addendum form without them."  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – [Monday, 9 September 2024 at 20.07]:**  
- Followed up with Avicenna team regarding the bundle ID for Mood Snapshot app.  
- *Key quote:* "Could you advise wrt ‘budle ID’?"  

- **[SensorKit Request] (Review Team, Apple) – [Monday, 9 September 2024 at 20.03]:**  
- Requested bundle ID to proceed with granting development entitlement.  
- *Key quote:* "Can you please provide the bundle ID for your application?"  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – [Monday, September 16, 2024 12:51:54 PM]:**  
- Followed up again with Avicenna team regarding bundle ID and development entitlement status.  
- *Key quote:* "Just bringing this to your attention again – could you advise wrt ‘bundle ID’?"  

- **[Amin Tavassolian] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Thursday, October 3, 2024 at 1:58:25 PM]:**  
- Acknowledged the request for bundle ID and promised to provide it soon.  
- *Key quote:* "I asked the team to share this info with us asap."  

- **[Amin Tavassolian] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Thursday, October 3, 2024 at 2:28:45 PM]:**  
- Provided the bundle ID: com.avicenna.hri3805.  
- *Key quote:* "The identifier is: com.avicenna.hri3805."  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – [Thursday, October 3, 2024 11:58:44 PM]:**  
- Acknowledged receipt of the bundle ID.  
- *Key quote:* "Thanks Amin!"  

#### **2. Timeline**  
- **[26 August 2024]:** Camilla submitted the filled research proposal form.  
- **[27 August 2024]:** Apple explained the two stages of entitlements and requested signed agreements.  
- **[30 August 2024]:** Camilla notified Apple about missing data types in the Addendum.  
- **[9 September 2024]:** Apple requested bundle ID for the app.  
- **[3 October 2024]:** Amin provided the bundle ID.  

#### **3. Key Events/Issues**  
- **Issue 1:** Missing data types (Heart Rate, Wrist Temperature) in the Addendum.  
- **Feedback Submission:** Camilla provided feedback on the missing data types and submitted required documents.  
- **Access/Login Issues:** No login issues reported, but bundle ID was required to proceed.  

#### **4. Action Items**  
- **Pending:**  
- Apple to grant development entitlement upon receipt of bundle ID.  
- **Completed:**  
- Submission of research proposal form.  
- Provision of bundle ID by Avicenna Research.  

#### **5. Technical Details**  
- **Account/Login Info:** Not applicable.  
- **Study ID/Project Code:** Mood Snapshot app (ID #6503913823).  

#### **6. Next Steps**  
- **Action 1:** Apple to process development entitlement (assigned to SensorKit Review Team).  
- **Action 2:** Camilla to follow up on distribution entitlement (assigned to Camilla Michalski).
